Container.Name: MCP-SSH-Server
Container.Overview: TypeScript MCP server that securely executes arbitrary commands on remote hosts via SSH. Exposes an authentication portal for generating API keys.

Config.Name: Host Port
Config.Description: The external port mapping for the MCP SSE interface.

Config.Name: Doppler Token
Config.Description: Doppler Service Token to fetch JWT_SECRET, GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, and proxy configs.

Config.Name: Debug Mode
Config.Description: Set to 'true' to enable verbose observability logging for connections and SSH executions.
